about: Every v1 feature and its v2 home. rows = §A (06 Advanced ITEMS) + §B (G0-D); v2 = registry action id / testid / where-path, filled by the package that builds the home; map = v1-manifest entry id → row id, action:<registry id> or testid:<hook> (scripts/v2-manifest/map-entries.mjs); excluded = entry id → why it is not a v1 feature. Audited by scripts/check-v2-nothing-deleted.mjs.
